title: ImportSnare: Directed "Code Manual" Hijacking in Retrieval-Augmented Code Generation
authors: Kai Ye; Liangcai Su; Chenxiong Qian
why_relevant: Presents a novel RAG poisoning attack targeting retrieval-augmented code generation, manipulating both retrieval ranking and LLM generation to recommend malicious dependencies, with a released benchmark.
why_not_or_caveat: Domain-specific to code generation rather than general RAG QA.
